bound_assumptions: Two sheep receive the same daily FEED/CARE and generic HARVEST schedule as the two cows.
The upper bound credits all 44 possible sheep wool units at the maximum future baseline WOOL price.
The upper bound sets forgone cow MILK revenue to zero and still subtracts only the 200 extra purchase cost.
Favorable price feedback uses requested transaction quantities as if all filled and applies the worst local 42-unit MILK scarcity or 44-unit WOOL supply price shift to every eligible request.
Adverse opponent effects, labor conflicts, delayed cash, and negative wool-price feedback on the new wool itself are omitted from the upper bound.
The lower bound credits zero wool revenue and debits maximum-price forgone cow milk plus worst requested-quantity adverse feedback.
